observation.new_ssh_login: authentication succeeds but chdir and /bin/bash fail with Permission denied

impact: Robot-side repository sync, build, ROS observation and hardware validation cannot run from the astrabot account.
required_recovery: Use a local console or an existing administrator session to inspect directory modes, ACLs and mounts, then restore normal traversal permissions on the exact affected directories.
prohibited_recovery: Do not recursively chmod the filesystem and do not reboot while the existing shell is the only live diagnostic session.
